thread:
Maya: FYI — Acme (CS-2024-0912) flagged a noticeable quality regression after the speculative/draft sampler rollout last night. They say the model now omits steps in multi-step answers and returns shorter, less detailed responses. Request IDs: req-8f3c, req-8f3d, req-8f44. Posting repro and payload below.

support-bot: ticket CS-2024-0912 created and linked to Acme account (priority: high).

Junaid: thanks — can you paste one of the full API payloads and a before/after example? also which model variant did they hit (stable vs draft)?

Maya: here's the minimal repro they provided. Note: they say this used to be fine before the speculative rollout.

Maya: Prompt (user):
"""
You are an expert product manager. Outline a 5-step go-to-market plan for a B2B analytics feature. Include timeline and risks.
"""

Maya: Expected (old): long, step-by-step plan with timelines and risk bullets (~300-400 tokens).
Maya: Actual (new): single short paragraph and misses risk items (~40 tokens).

Maya: Payload (redacted):
```json
{
  "model": "redwood/og-13b",
  "speculative_sampling": true,
  "draft_multiplier": 1.5,
  "draft_temperature": 0.9,
  "final_temperature": 0.2,
  "max_tokens": 512,
  "top_p": 0.95,
  "prompt": "<user prompt above>",
  "customer_id": "acme-corp",
  "request_id": "req-8f3c"
}
```

Junaid: interesting — speculative_sampling true means we run a cheap draft sampler then final model. quick checks: did this customer get routed to a quantized draft variant? any seed or deterministic flags?

Maya: they didn't set seed. From our logs they hit model variant "og-13b-draft-q4_1" for the draft path and "og-13b-fp16" for final.

Lee: runtime note — I pulled the draft-path traces for req-8f3c/8f3d. Saw elevated KV-cache misses and a fallback on the draft path to the legacy kernel for certain sequence lengths. snippet: 
```
[2028-03-05T21:04:12Z] draft_path: INFO start req-8f3c seq_len=78
[2028-03-05T21:04:12Z] draft_kernel: WARN kernel_fallback=true reason=layout-mismatch
[2028-03-05T21:04:12Z] draft_path: ERROR kv_cache_mismatch detected; truncated_final_output=39 tokens
```
This lines up with truncated/abbreviated final outputs. The fallback seems to drop some of the KV cache that the final model expects.

Junaid: that would definitely change content because the final decoding context is missing. short-term mitigation: disable speculative_sampling for Acme or reduce draft_temperature/draft_multiplier so draft doesn't diverge and we don't hit the fallback. can you try toggling rollout for just that customer?

Olivia: we have a rollout flag: speculative_draft_rollout_pct. I can set a per-customer override to 0 for acme-corp in the console — do you want that now, Maya?

Maya: please do it, Olivia. I'll tell Acme support team the change is in flight.

Olivia: done — speculative_draft_rollout_pct=0 (override) for acme-corp. routing now forces stable final-only path.

Maya: Acme confirmed they got a new response after the override. Still repro-able on our internal replays though when we force the draft path. Example of failing replay (req-8f44) shows hallucinated next-step and early termination.

Junaid: for a temporary config workaround we should also try lowering draft_temperature to 0.6 and set draft_multiplier to 1.2 for the broader rollout while we fix kernel incompatibility. But per-customer override is safest for now.

Lee: root-cause candidate: a change last week to the quantized weight layout for the draft-only execution path (PR #4821) + a continuous-batching change created an alignment mismatch for sequence lengths >64. I'll revert the draft-only layout change on the next patch and add a compatibility test for seq_len ranges.

Junaid: I'll open a PR to revert and add a regression test that replays previously seen request IDs. tagging eng-ml to prioritize. (JIRA ENG-7621).

Olivia: action items: 1) rollback draft layout (eng-runtime) 2) add seq_len regression tests (eng-ml) 3) run broader canary with draft_temperature 0.6/draft_multiplier 1.2 (product + eng) 4) notify Acme + CS. I'll draft a short customer note.

Maya: quick note for CS-2024-0912: customer is satisfied with per-customer override, wants ETA for full fix. I'll ask for ETA and keep ticket open.

support-bot: note added to ticket CS-2024-0912: rollback scheduled; follow-up planned in 24h.

Junaid: assigning to me and Lee. I'll follow up with PR link and schedule a hotfix if tests fail.

Lee: got it — will prioritize a hotfix. leaving logs/trace links in the ticket: https://internal.redwood/traces/req-8f3c (internal).

Olivia: also creating a short postmortem doc and will coordinate a customer-facing summary.

Maya: thanks all — I'll update Acme and close the loop once we have the hotfix ETA.
